text: As I stand here, the air feels thick with the promise of ideas yet to be born. The bright, modern space, veiled by glass and dappled with bold colors, beckons curiosity. The words "R+D" on the wall evoke a sense of restless human ambition—the drive to inquire, disrupt, and create. I feel inspired, yet humbled, contemplating the intimate dance between what is known and what still awaits discovery. My presence here is both witness and participant to the unfolding story of human ingenuity.
